artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $f:(\mathbb{C}^n,0)\to(\mathbb{C}^n,0)$ be a holomorphic germ with $f(z)=Az+O(\|z\|^2)$, where $A\in\mathrm{GL}_n(\mathbb{C})$ has distinct eigenvalues $\lambda_1,\dots,\lambda_n$ satisfying the nonresonance condition
$$\lambda^k-\lambda_j:=\lambda_1^{k_1}\cdots\lambda_n^{k_n}-\lambda_j\neq 0\quad\text{for all } j\in\{1,\dots,n\}\text{ and all } k=(k_1,\dots,k_n)\in\mathbb{N}^n\text{ with }|k|=k_1+\cdots+k_n\geq 2.$$
Under this condition, $f$ is formally linearizable: there is a unique formal power series tangent to the identity that conjugates $f$ to its linear part $A$. Say that $f$ is analytically linearizable if this formal conjugacy converges in a neighborhood of $0$.

Determine the optimal arithmetic condition on the eigenvalues $(\lambda_1,\dots,\lambda_n)$ that guarantees the analytic linearizability of every such germ $f$, and decide whether this optimal condition can be obtained via a direct majorant-series argument.
artifact.category_tag: small divisors and linearization of holomorphic germs
artifact.status_search_result: In one complex dimension the optimal arithmetic condition is the Brjuno condition (Brjuno's sufficiency, Yoccoz's necessity for quadratic polynomials). In several variables the optimal arithmetic condition guaranteeing analytic linearizability for all nonresonant germs with a given linear part is not known; multidimensional Brjuno-type conditions (Brjuno, Rüssmann, Pöschel) are known sufficient, but their optimality and a direct majorant-series proof of the optimal condition remain open.

status_evidence.title: Siegel Discs, Herman Rings and the Arnold Family
status_evidence.snippet: Brjuno's condition is the optimal arithmetic condition for linearizability of quadratic polynomials; whether it is necessary in higher degree or in several variables remains open.
status_evidence.claim: Optimality of Brjuno-type conditions beyond the one-dimensional quadratic case is not established.

status_evidence.title: Scholarpedia: Siegel disks (Buff)
status_evidence.snippet: Discusses Brjuno and Herman conditions as optimal in dimension one; multidimensional analogues are open.
status_evidence.claim: The optimal arithmetic condition in several variables is not known.
